summary: Implemented and verified phases 1-3 of the 13-phase input-scoped gate invalidation plan. Phase 1 hardened measure-gate-costs.sh with per-run (not only per-pass) load capture, a per-row validity column, a file-level ALL_VALID header, and overwrite protection against a contaminated run clobbering a previously-clean artifact. Phase 2 added and populated a 9th input_corpus field across all 23 gates in gate-registry.data, with lint enforcement for field count and corpus-grammar conformance. Phase 3 built a new content-addressed corpus+implementation digest library (gate-cache-lib.sh) with a 16-case regression suite, fixing four real bugs found via live testing before they shipped (git-ls-files-vs-gitignored-tree resolution gap, a command-substitution subshell variable-scoping bug, a regex-escaping defect, and a test-harness path-arithmetic error). Each phase committed separately; 60 total new/updated test cases pass across the three touched suites, 0 shellcheck findings. 10 phases remain -- Phase 4 (gate 8 root-cause, needs an idle host that was mostly unavailable this dispatch) and Phase 5 (the first real caller of the new digest library) are next.

artifacts.summary: Phases 1-3 of 13: measurement-harness hardening, per-gate input_corpus declaration, and the content-addressed digest library.
Concrete resume point for Phase 4/Phase 5, plus four implementation bugs found/fixed during Phase 3 that a successor must not reintroduce.
